scope: PMP22 RBP binding plus perturbation: complete ENCORE screen and independent processed PUM/CNOT endpoint audit in K562, HepG2, TCam-2, HCT116 and HEK293. No raw processing or cell-context transfer.
known_baseline: Inherited miR29/IRE1 and G3BP1 are prior findings, not discovery. QKI-PMP22 isoform changes are published in PMC13234107; primer-specific mechanism unresolved. PMID19605561 abstract already explicitly describes CNOT7/8-PMP22 repression. PUM source supplements already contain the re-examined measurements. See LABBOOK.md and outputs/novelty-focused-r001.json.
budget_allocation: Completed full eligible ENCORE screen, batch sensitivity and three independent processed resources; prioritized native full backgrounds, uncertainty, source controls, endpoint distinctions and exact peer-artifact reuse over raw processing. No time/request cap is asserted. Disk reserve was enforced during acquisition.
stopping_reason: The authorized bounded analysis is complete: strict joint nomination remains empty; an independent locked fate prediction fails; a conditional PUM1 abundance association is retained without relaxing binding criteria; positive CNOT abundance effects are already known at pathway level. Further discrimination requires same-context transcript-end/functional-site tests or repair of the BruChase source export, rather than more selection of convenient positive rows. Late peer evidence establishes positive Pum1/Pum2/Tia1/Igf2bp2/Snd1 transcript coverage in rat Schwann cultures, not protein activity or expressed-site/functional transfer. Qki remains unmapped. Prior ledger revision preserved as object39359bf59ba3ef2eefb67cf1224af978d830ae7bcb73a31f9f550175f760ca19.
no_candidates_reason: No validated strict joint binding-plus-abundance candidate; the records below distinguish an unresolved hypothesis, a conditional abundance association and a reproduced known pathway response.

candidates.claim: Combined PUM1/PUM2 depletion increases PMP22 labeled-RNA persistence in HEK293 cells.
candidates.context: GSE145237 HEK293; 48h dual RNAi, 30min BrU pulse, 0/6h chase, four biological culture replicates per arm/time. Prior binding lead was PUM2 in K562, not HEK293 site occupancy.
alternatives: Modest persistence effect below the test's support
candidates.validation_result: Frozen positive-FDR rule failed: deposited interaction +0.2441 log2, 95% Wald CI[-0.1061,0.5943], p0.1719, q0.5606. Source feature class NOEFFECT at its 1.75-fold practical threshold. This is failed support, not significant opposite direction or global absence of action.
candidates.independence_assessment: Seal preceded first inspection of this target coefficient row and has unchanged bytes. Source paper-wide outcomes were known and model prior exposure cannot be excluded. Different study/assay/cell context from K562; it tests transportability, not exact single-PUM2 replication. No shared-control sign-count or donor-independence claim.

closest_prior_work.relationship: Measurements and NOEFFECT/BOUND annotations were already public; new contribution is the executed screen-linked failure of a declared prediction, not new biological data.

searches.query: (PMP22 OR peripheral myelin protein 22) AND (PUM1 OR PUM2 OR Pumilio)

novelty.limitation: Search metadata and inspected supplements are bounded; this is not a claim of global novelty or absence of prior target studies.

candidates.limitations: All five time-term fields duplicate interaction fields in every source row; report interaction as deposited, not independently refitted kinetics. Relative persistence is not an absolute decay constant. No directly measured Schwann transfer.
candidates.next_test: Obtain corrected source coefficients/processed labeled-count design, then test adequately depleted PUM1/2 and endogenous PMP22 site disruption in the same defined cell context with labeled-RNA persistence and verified transcript ends. A reproducible site-dependent positive interaction would challenge the present negative nomination.

candidates.claim: PUM1 depletion is associated with modestly increased PMP22 abundance after the study's final four-hour ActD exposure in TCam-2.
candidates.context: GSE123016; control GSM3490755/56/57 and PUM1 GSM3490758/59/60; three biological culture transfections per arm, 72h RNAi. Full Cuffdiff tables, not significant lists alone.
candidates.validation_result: PMP22 +0.393787 log2(KD/control), raw p0.00105, source q0.0150862; PUM2 +0.244258,q0.189761. PUM1 RIP/IgG +1.7785log2 but RIP/total +0.589082, below source twofold requirement; strict joint candidate fails. HCT116 single-PUM1 q1 and dual-PUM q0.3405 do not establish independent abundance replication.
candidates.independence_assessment: Separate study/context from ENCORE. TCam sample pilot and supplement rows were inspected before this result audit; no prospective credit. Single-PUM contrasts share the same study controls; Cuffdiff estimates are source computations, not refitted counts.

closest_prior_work.locator: Supplemental Tables S7 and S9, complete Cuffdiff PMP22 rows
closest_prior_work.relationship: Conditional abundance measurement and subthreshold binding-background comparison already existed incidentally; reanalysis connects them to the current RBP question without claiming first discovery.

searches.query: (PMP22 OR peripheral myelin protein 22) AND (PUM1 OR PUM2 OR Pumilio)

novelty.limitation: A prior-table observation is not a newly validated direct regulator.

candidates.limitations: No time-zero baseline, fitted decay curve or source SE. Source strict binding threshold fails, so not promoted into the requested validated joint set. No Schwann context or site-functional validation.
candidates.next_test: Measure arm-specific pre-ActD abundance or metabolically labeled persistence and test endogenous binding-site dependence in TCam-2 before extrapolating the PUM1 abundance response to Schwann cells.

candidates.claim: CNOT1 or joint CNOT7/8 depletion increases captured polyadenylated PMP22 RNA in HCT116.
candidates.context: GSE159510 HCT116; three biological culture replicates per condition; 48h RNAi; PAC-seq gene summary, not a rate measurement.
alternatives: RNA synthesis or processing rather than changed stability
candidates.validation_result: PMP22 +1.0358log2(q2.2291e-5) for CNOT1 and +0.9926(q3.8991e-5) for CNOT7/8. PUM single/dual estimates are positive but nonsignificant. This does not statistically establish a difference between the CNOT and PUM effects.
candidates.independence_assessment: HCT116 provides context corroboration of the older MCF7 CNOT/PMP22 connection (PMID19605561 abstract), not new measurements or replication of direct binding. HCT contrasts share study controls; no pooled inference.

closest_prior_work.relationship: Explicitly reports CNOT7/8-associated repression of PMP22 in MCF7. Fulltext retrieval failed and no decay/half-life detail is inferred from the abstract.

closest_prior_work.locator: Supplemental Table S2, PMP22 gene-summary rows
closest_prior_work.relationship: Present positive HCT116 measurements were already public.

searches.query: (PMP22 OR peripheral myelin protein 22) AND (CNOT1 OR CNOT7 OR CNOT8 OR CCR4-NOT)

novelty.limitation: 100 of103 search hits returned; sufficient known prior found, not exhaustive novelty clearance.

candidates.limitations: No demonstrated PMP22 binding by the CNOT subunits; no PUM mediation, fitted decay rate, Schwann transfer or SE reconstructed from adjusted p. Not admitted to the strict RBP binding-plus-abundance set.
candidates.next_test: In the same context, determine whether a target-site-dependent PUM intervention affects PMP22 fate and whether CNOT response persists when those sites are disrupted; distinguish direct recruitment from broad RNA/state changes.
